children: Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited (NSE:KOTAKBANK) showed robust loan and deposit growth, strong Neo platform earnings and rising analyst price targets as leadership clarity with incoming CEO Anup Kumar Saha and favorable repricing under EBLR boost outlook amid near-term NIM pressure.
Previous Week Recap
Kotak Advances, Deposits Growth
: Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK): net advances ₹5.77L crore (+24.7% YoY); avg advances ₹5.47L (+22.1% YoY, +10.5% QoQ); avg deposits ₹6.06L (+18.8% YoY); CASA ₹2.49L (+11.3% YoY).
Analysts Lift KOTAKBANK Targets
: Analysts raised Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) price targets: HSBC Rs520, Goldman Rs540, Citi Rs465; cited stronger loan growth, deposit momentum, improved liquidity and upward earnings revisions.
RBI Approves Anup Kumar Saha

: RBI approved Anup Kumar Saha as Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) CEO from Jan 1, 2027. Saha, joining in Jan 2026, currently oversees retail banking, data analytics, marketing and government business.
FCNR(B) Deposits, Advances
: KOTAKBANK reported $5.78B in FCNR(B) deposits under RBI swap as of Sept 30; international branches had ~$1.68B in advances tied to those deposits. Figures provisional, subject to review.
RBI Hints Rate Lift, NIM Impact
: RBI likely to lift policy rate 25 bp to 5.50% in Oct 2026. Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) benefits under EBLR as its floating retail/MSME loans reprice quickly, impacting near-term NIMs.
Jefferies Adds To Model Portfolio
: Jefferies India added Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) to its model portfolio Oct 6, 2026 with 2% weight, citing leadership clarity, faster growth (~15%+) and ~1.8x FY27E P/ABV.
Kotak Trading At Discount
: Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) trades near 1.8x FY27 price-to-adjusted book value, about 50% below its 10-year average, per Jefferies' valuation note.
Motilal Oswal 2QFY27 Outlook
: Motilal Oswal forecasts Kotak Mahindra Bank (KOTAKBANK) 2QFY27: NII up ~14% YoY, ~5.1% QoQ; NIMs down 8–20 bps due to fast loan growth and FCNR(B) inflows.
Kotak Neo FY25-26 Metrics
: KOTAKBANK: Kotak Neo FY25-26 income ₹5,461cr, net profit ₹1,664cr. Market shares: equities 13.2%, derivatives 15%, commodities 18%. Clients 67.52 lakh; DP assets ₹17 lakh crore; execution <50 ms.
Shares Near ₹416.50; Update
: KOTAKBANK shares closed near ₹416.50 before an October update. Year-to-date down ~6%, 12-month down ~3%. After provisional results and loan/deposit data, intraday rose about 4% to ~₹432.6.
